headline: Record margins overshadowed by a bitcoin-driven profit swing
summary_short: Block reported Q2 2026 revenue of $6,618M (+9.3% y/y) and a record Adjusted Operating Income of $864M (27% margin), but GAAP net income fell to $89M and diluted EPS to $0.15 as a swing from a $212M bitcoin-remeasurement gain a year ago to an $88M loss this quarter offset otherwise-strong operating momentum.
summary_long: Gross profit grew 25% y/y to $3.17B, led by Cash App (+31%) and Square (+13%), pushing Adjusted Operating Income to a record $864M (27% margin) and Adjusted Diluted EPS to a record $1.02 (+65% y/y). GAAP operating income fell 7.7% y/y to $447M and net income fell to $89M from $538M, mostly because the prior-year quarter booked a $212M bitcoin-remeasurement gain versus an $88M loss this quarter; G&A also rose 84% y/y on higher legal contingencies. The company repaid $1.575B of senior notes and convertible debt in H1, cutting long-term debt 21.6% q/q to $5.72B, while cash fell 6.3% q/q to $6.43B. Block raised FY2026 guidance to $12.51B gross profit (+21% y/y) and $4.02 Adjusted Diluted EPS (+70% y/y).

drivers.explanation: Company cites 25% y/y gross profit growth, a record 27% Adjusted Operating Income margin, and record Adjusted EBITDA, led by Cash App (+31% y/y) and Square (+13% y/y); full-year guidance was raised on this momentum.

Growth driven by Cash App Commerce Enablement volume +17% y/y to $56.5B and Consumer Lending origination +59% y/y to $18.9B, plus Square GPV +13% y/y to $72.8B; Bitcoin Ecosystem revenue declined y/y on reduced trading fees.

GAAP EPS fell y/y mainly because Q2 2025 booked a $212M pretax bitcoin-remeasurement gain versus an $88M pretax loss this quarter, a swing unrelated to core operations; non-GAAP Adjusted Diluted EPS instead grew 65% y/y to $1.02.

Reflects the same bitcoin-remeasurement swing (a $212M gain a year ago vs. an $88M loss this quarter) plus a higher tax provision, even as Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Operating Income both hit records in the same quarter.

Not framed as a discrete y/y driver in the release; per the filed income statement, G&A rose 84% y/y on increased accrued legal contingencies, outpacing gross profit growth on a GAAP basis, while Adjusted Operating Income (which excludes those charges) hit a record $864M.

Cash App gross profit grew 31% y/y on Commerce Enablement (BNPL, Cash App Card) and Financial Solutions (Cash App Borrow); Square gross profit grew 13% y/y on Commerce Enablement plus a one-time tariff reimbursement (~2 points), partly offset by a 31% y/y decline in Bitcoin Ecosystem gross profit.

Not decomposed on this generic (non-adjusted) basis by the company; the release's own Adjusted EBITDA measure hit a record $1.169B, reflecting the same gross-profit growth and expense discipline behind the Adjusted Operating Income record.

Not explained as a single driver in the release; per the filed cash-flow statement, $1.575B of debt repayments (senior notes plus convertible notes) and $701M of YTD share buybacks outweighed $1.02B of quarterly operating cash flow.

Company repaid $1.0B of senior notes and redeemed $575M of convertible notes in H1 2026 per the cash-flow statement, reducing long-term debt q/q; not called out as a narrative point in the letter itself.
Not explained in the release; the modest q/q increase is consistent with retained earnings from net income being only partly offset by share repurchases and other comprehensive items.
